name: ToolbarButton
summary: Button tuned for use inside a Toolbar.

props.name: variant
props.description: Ghost by default: inside a toolbar the surface already frames the action. `secondary` is the neutral fill with the brand-coloured label; `tertiary` the neutral fill with the plain label (the default).

props.name: appearance
props.type: solid | outline | ghost | link | nav | soft
props.description: Inherited from Button. How much weight the box carries; the default here is ghost.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | brand | danger | success | warning | info
props.description: Inherited from Button. What the colour means; every combination exists.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Toggle inside the toolbar (bold, italic). aria-pressed, not a variant.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Same icon API as Button; every Button prop is accepted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stays in the roving order but is not activatable, so the set does not shift.

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step, shared with Button. Responsive.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an <a> instead of a <button>: a toolbar item that NAVIGATES has to be a link, or middle-click and open-in-new-tab stop working.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the spinner and sets aria-busy.

props.name: kbd
props.description: Shows the shortcut and announces it with aria-keyshortcuts. A list (["Ctrl", "K"]) shows one key cap per key and announces the combination (Control+K).

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of the container.

props.name: grow
props.description: In a row (Cluster), takes an equal share with the other buttons that also grow. `fullWidth` asks for the whole line instead.

props.name: render
props.description: Inherited from Button: the element that renders the button — the router's link, for example — receiving the Aurea skin and the content.

props.name: quiet
props.description: Less weight: muted text one step smaller — the Button's quiet.

props.name: pressedStyle
props.description: The colour of the ON state (ADR-0084): brand — the yellow of the primary button, the default — neutral (grey) or contrast (graphite, inverted). Written as data-pressed-style; the same attribute on a container, or on <html>, sets it for every pressed button inside, and a button's own value wins. With the system's "increase contrast", neutral gets a 3:1 outline.
